usage.callShape: POST https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/llm/glm with JSON body {model, messages[], max_tokens}
usage.outputShape: body.content (final assistant answer, plain string); body.model (actual served model); body.usage.total_tokens / body.usage.cost
quirks: This gateway endpoint (/api/llm/glm) does NOT return the OpenAI chat-completions shape: the answer is at body.content directly, NOT body.choices[0].message.content.
Send a standard chat body: {model:'glm-4.6', messages:[{role,content}], max_tokens}. model 'glm-4.6' is accepted but the gateway actually serves z-ai/glm-5-20260211 (reported in body.model).

GLM has chain-of-thought on by default: reasoning_tokens (e.g. 215) are consumed and counted against max_tokens, but the reasoning text is NOT surfaced in this response shape — only the final body.content is returned. Set a generous max_tokens (256+) so the answer isn't truncated by reasoning budget.
Flat-priced x402 call at $0.030 on Base regardless of token usage (body.usage.cost reflects upstream model cost, not what you pay).
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {model:"glm-4.6", messages:[{role:"user",content:"..."}], max_tokens:256} to https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/llm/glm; payment is x402 (~$0.03 USDC on Base, flat per call). Read the assistant's answer from body.content (a plain string) — note this gateway does NOT use the OpenAI choices[] shape. Use a generous max_tokens (256+) because GLM reasoning tokens count against it; the chain-of-thought itself is not returned, only the final answer. Single synchronous JSON response, no auth beyond the x402 payment.
